evidence.detail: Existing /scry command calls fetcher.search_scryfall() exclusively — no local rotation data path
No rotation-specific search command exists in discordbot/commands/
dreadrise.py provides a partial workaround: PD-legal first, then others, but still calls external Dreadrise API not local rotation files

triage.notes: Requires product decisions: command name, whether it wraps the internal find engine (find/search.py) with f:pd, or queries rotation-run file data directly (magic/rotation.py:read_rotation_files). The distinction matters for pre-rotation-complete season queries.
